title: 鶴岡市「ととこ」— 庄内鴨の串焼きと鴨しゃぶが味わえる居酒屋
summary: 鶴岡市泉町の居酒屋「ととこ」。鶏だけでなく、旨味たっぷりの「庄内鴨」の串焼きが味わえます。鴨しゃぶや、鴨を丸ごと使った「カモパッチョ」など、鴨づくしのメニューも。

cover.alt: 庄内鴨の串焼き、鴨しゃぶ、カモパッチョを描いた水彩調イラスト

en.title: Tsuruoka City's "Totoko" — An izakaya where you can enjoy Shonai duck skewers and duck shabu-shabu
en.summary: "Totoko," an izakaya in Izumicho, Tsuruoka City. In addition to chicken, you can enjoy skewers of flavorful "Shonai duck." The menu also features a variety of duck dishes, such as duck shabu-shabu and "Kamo Paccho" made with a whole duck.
en.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of Shonai duck skewers, duck shabu-shabu, and duck paccho
en.html:
This is "Totoko," an izakaya in Izumicho, Tsuruoka City.

The post highlights that you can enjoy not only chicken, but also flavorful "Shonai duck" skewers. The menu also features a variety of creative duck dishes, such as duck shabu-shabu and "Kamo Paccho" made with a whole duck. This is a must-visit spot for anyone wanting to experience the deliciousness of Shonai duck.

You can find the restaurant's location and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: Threads post

markdown:
鶴岡市泉町にある居酒屋「ととこ」です。

投稿では、鶏だけでなく、旨味たっぷりの「庄内鴨」の串焼きが味わえることが紹介されています。さらに鴨しゃぶや、鴨を丸ごと使った「カモパッチョ」など、オリジナリティあふれる鴨メニューも揃います。庄内鴨の美味しさを体験したいときに訪れたい一軒です。

お店の場所・営業時間は、この記事下部の「お店の場所」からGoogleマップで確認できます。

出典: [Threadsの投稿](https://www.threads.com/@motched_shonai/post/DY9dHeRgc5X)
